route.rationale: Critical false-pass authority boundary: stale evidence could skip current execution, mint VerifiedReuse, and reconcile CompleteExecution after candidate mutation. The correction spans dirty capture, planning, executed capture, observation, dependency results, reuse, and report reconciliation.

changes.summary: Removed the public caller-implementable RoutineSession trait and its re-export. Added one internal current-binding boundary that accepts only a concrete LiveContext, revalidates it, derives RoutineBinding from that validated context, and distinguishes stale-context from mid-operation mutation failures. RoutineBinding remains inspectable data but is accepted by no authority-bearing public routine function.

LocalDirtyTree::capture and plan_routine now accept only &LiveContext, validate before work, and revalidate the same binding after work. DirtySnapshot construction is crate-confined so external callers cannot synthesize snapshot authority from a cloned RoutineBinding.

Reuse expectation creation, executed-result capture, result observation, dependency-result derivation, and reuse assessment now require a concrete current LiveContext and validate it before and after successful evidence minting. DependencyResult now carries opaque origin binding and must match the same plan, node, scope, dependency closure, candidate, root, configuration, selected inputs, and tool set before downstream use. Existing opaque executed, observed, receipt, and VerifiedReuse evidence remains non-caller-constructible.

reconcile_report now requires &LiveContext, rejects a stale plan before reconciliation, revalidates after reconciliation, and binds report identity to the current binding, context, candidate, and plan. A retained old plan or old VerifiedReuse cannot produce a current CompleteExecution report after tracked mutation.

Replaced forged FixedSession and SwitchingSession controls with real LiveContext flows and deterministic thread-local hooks that exist only under cfg(test). Added compile-time concrete-signature witnesses; tracked and untracked mutation controls across capture, plan, expectation, executed capture, observation, dependency results, reuse, and report; fresh configuration/input/tool substitutions; cross-plan dependency substitution; and a complete-record report race that must fail before CompleteExecution. Existing clean/dirty, repeat-use, fallback, closure, duplicate/unknown/missing evidence, special-file, artifact-swap, zero-write, and executed/reused/missing report controls are preserved.
